title: Add transaction/rollback system for pipeline database operations
description: The pipeline in _create_report (incident_service.py) inserts incidents and industry overviews before the source, leaving orphaned documents if source insert fails. Current workaround deletes orphans in error handlers, but a proper solution should use MongoDB multi-document transactions (session.start_transaction) or a compensating transaction pattern to guarantee atomicity. Consider: MongoDB 4.x+ transactions via motor/beanie session support, or a staged insert pattern where all documents are inserted together with rollback on any failure.
